messages:
harper: Notifying folks: recurring issue with missing spans -> bad aggregation totals resurfaced this morning. Postmortem from June said we'd add a weekly reconciliation job and an overflow bucket, but looks like reconciliation didn't catch this window. We should crisply assign remaining work and close the loop.
june: thanks. Symptoms: aggregator emitted zero for several product keys for ~90 minutes. Root cause trace: late spans routed to null-trace path because trace_id gen failed on malformed payloads. ETL then filtered nulls before aggregation.
sre-bot: incident_alert: trace_ingest_gap detected at 2025-01-14T08:07:31Z component=trace-ingest lag=12m
alex: proposed immediate triage checklist: 1) hotfix ETL to route malformed spans to overflow bucket (owner=june) 2) run targeted backfill for affected product keys (owner=alex) 3) enable weekly reconciliation job (owner=taylor) 4) update postmortem with exact owners + due dates (owner=harper).
harper: timeline: hotfix within 2h, sampling & small backfill within 6h, full backfill and verification within 24h, postmortem update + followup in 48h.
june: I'll prepare hotfix PR with a feature flag; small change to coalesce missing trace_ids to generated id and tag rows with "ingest_fix=v1". ETA PR in 50m.
taylor: I'll run the reconciliation sampler now to enumerate affected windows and keys. SQL I'm running: ```sql
SELECT product_id, window_start, sum(event_count) as raw_count, sum(coalesce(agg_count,0)) as agg_count, (sum(raw_count) - sum(coalesce(agg_count,0))) as delta
FROM reconciliation_sampler
WHERE ingestion_time >= now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY product_id, window_start
HAVING abs(sum(raw_count) - sum(coalesce(agg_count,0))) > 5
ORDER BY abs(delta) DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
alex: Backfill approach: prioritized recompute for top-N product keys from sampler, idempotent upserts into aggregator_canonical with reconciled_by='postmortem-2025-01-14'. I'll draft the job and share sample delta estimates.
harper: owners: june=hotfix+merge, alex=backfill execution+validation, taylor=reconciliation job+dashboards, harper=postmortem owner+prod comms. Add due dates: hotfix by 2h, sample by 3h, backfill start by 6h, postmortem updated within 48h.
sre-bot: deploy_event: hotfix-pr/291 opened at 2025-01-14T08:50:12Z by june
june: note: hotfix will temporarily increase cardinality for some keys (overflow tag). I'll post expected cardinality delta in #analytics once I have sample.
taylor: I'll wire the weekly reconciliation job into the observability cron and add a dashboard panel for "reconciliation_delta_rate". Alert threshold suggestion: page when delta_rate > 0.5% sustained for 30m.
alex: I'll include a small smoke test for the backfill that runs against a staging slice and validates that aggregator totals move closer to raw counts. Also planning to annotate all changed windows with reconciliation metadata so analytics can audit.
harper: action item: add postmortem checklist entry "verify weekly reconciliation runs for 4 consecutive weeks" before we mark postmortem as closed. Assign to taylor.
june: PR ready for review, putting it in the review queue now. tagging @alex for backfill coordination.
alex: will review and stand by to kick off backfill once hotfix is live.
sre-bot: deploy_event: hotfix-pr/291 merged to main at 2025-01-14T09:30:05Z
taylor: sampler results posted in #eng-data: top 20 product keys show deltas ranging 8-240 events, mostly under 1% impact except 3 keys at ~3-4%. Posting summary and recommended backfill order.
harper: thanks. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners/dates and close the loop once taylor confirms 4 weeks of reconciliation. Next check-in 12h or earlier if backfill finds unexpected churn. :white_check_mark:
